description: This file defines a custom exception class 'ConceptsLockedException' used in the OpenMRS project to signal that concept editing is currently locked by a configuration setting.

classes.name: ConceptsLockedException
classes.description: A custom exception class indicating that concept editing is locked, which extends APIException.

methods.name: ConceptsLockedException()
methods.description: Default constructor that initializes the exception with a standard message indicating concepts are locked.

methods.name: ConceptsLockedException(String message)
methods.description: Constructor allowing a custom message to be specified when the exception is thrown.

methods.name: ConceptsLockedException(String message, Throwable cause)
methods.description: Constructor allowing a custom message and a parent throwable cause.

methods.name: ConceptsLockedException(Throwable cause)
methods.description: Constructor allowing only a parent throwable cause, used to chain exceptions.
